title: Beach sand silimanite for refractory industry
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the requirements of beachsand silimanite used in the manufacture of high alumina refractory products.

clause_2_normative_references.title: METHODS OF SAMPLING AND PHYSICAL TESTS FOR REFRACTORY MATERIALS, Part 1: DETERMINATION OF PYROMETRIC CONE EQUIVALENT (PCE) OR SOFTENING POINT

clause_3_terminology: Beach sand silimanite for refractory industry

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
